data.name: Biokolprodukter
data.description: Biokolprodukter is a Swedish biochar company established in 2019 that partners with bioenergy facilities (e.g. Solör Bioenergi, Cortus Energy) to co-produce biochar alongside heat/power. They sell biochar products for soil amendment, filtration, and construction (kolmakadam) along with EBC Global Biochar C-sink certified carbon credits.
